configurations.name: prototyp
runtimeArgs: $root = 'C:\prototyp'; $types = @{ '.html' = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'; '.css' = 'text/css; charset=utf-8'; '.js' = 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8'; '.pdf' = 'application/pdf'; '.txt' = 'text/plain; charset=utf-8'; '.md' = 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' }; $l = [System.Net.HttpListener]::new(); $l.Prefixes.Add('http://localhost:5510/'); $l.Start(); Write-Host 'Serving http://localhost:5510/'; while ($l.IsListening) { $c = $l.GetContext(); $p = [Uri]::UnescapeDataString($c.Request.Url.AbsolutePath.TrimStart('/')); if (-not $p) { $p = 'index.html' }; $f = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([IO.Path]::Combine($root, $p)); if ($f.StartsWith($root) -and [IO.File]::Exists($f)) { $b = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($f); $e = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($f).ToLower(); $c.Response.ContentType = $types[$e] ?? 'application/octet-stream'; $c.Response.Headers.Add('Cache-Control', 'no-store'); $c.Response.OutputStream.Write($b, 0, $b.Length) } else { $c.Response.StatusCode = 404 }; Write-Host $c.Request.HttpMethod $c.Request.Url.AbsolutePath $c.Response.StatusCode; $c.Response.Close() }
